results.canonical_news_title: Circuit Breaker Labs hopes to make AI safer for your kids (and you)

global_competitors.name: Circuit Breaker Labs
global_competitors.reason: High-risk conversational AI psychological-safety evaluation with simulated users.

global_competitors.name: Virtue AI
global_competitors.reason: AI safety evaluation/red-teaming workflows with test evidence.

global_competitors.name: Giskard
global_competitors.reason: LLM safety testing, test suites, reports and remediation workflow.

adjacent_competitors.name: Promptfoo
adjacent_competitors.reason: General open-source LLM eval/red-team framework; not psychological-safety persona workflow.

competition_search_terms: conversational AI psychological safety evaluation platform simulated users
Türkiye LLM güvenlik değerlendirme red team yazılımı
results.market_gap: Persona/scenario psychological-safety operations is narrower than generic LLM evals but sits at the global competitor ceiling.
results.mvp: Persona/scenario registry, manual transcript import, rubric scoring, findings, remediation/retest ledger.
results.working_logic: Teams define personas and risk scenarios, attach transcripts, score deterministic rubrics and track remediation.
results.marketing_strategy: AI safety/product assurance communities and high-risk app builders.
results.first_customer_plan: Pilot with a small conversational-AI team using manually supplied transcripts.
results.main_risk: Automated simulated-user generation would need model inference; zero-cost MVP must accept imported/manual test conversations.
results.validation_assumption: Workflow/evidence product can be useful without bundled paid inference.

global_competitors.name: Pilz
global_competitors.reason: Industrial robot/HRC safety assessment and validation for integrators/factories; same safety-readiness job though service-heavy.

adjacent_competitors.name: SICK Safety Assistant
adjacent_competitors.reason: Machine safety configuration tools, not humanoid task/standards evidence workspace.

competition_search_terms: humanoid robot safety risk assessment standards compliance software
Türkiye robot güvenlik risk değerlendirme yazılımı humanoid
results.market_gap: Humanoid-specific standards/evidence workspace remains early while incumbent machine-safety vendors are broader.
results.mvp: Task-risk register, standards checklist, evidence attachments, readiness review and export.
results.working_logic: Map task/environment hazards to selected standards requirements and required validation evidence.
results.marketing_strategy: Robot integrators, safety consultants, industrial automation associations.
results.first_customer_plan: Pilot on one non-production humanoid/robot task assessment.
results.main_risk: Full copyrighted standards text cannot be bundled freely; product must store user-entered/licensed requirement references.
results.validation_assumption: Metadata/checklist workflow is viable without redistributing standards.
results.local_applicability_rationale: No explicit local hypothesis on this candidate.

results.canonical_news_title: Hyundai Motor Group humanoid/robot deployment expansion

global_competitors.name: Formic
global_competitors.reason: Manufacturing automation deployment/readiness workflow, task qualification and rollout support; broader than humanoids but materially same buyer/job.

adjacent_competitors.name: Boston Dynamics Atlas
adjacent_competitors.reason: Humanoid platform/vendor, not vendor-neutral readiness workspace.

competition_search_terms: factory humanoid deployment readiness task assessment software
Türkiye fabrika robot otomasyon uygunluk değerlendirme yazılımı
results.market_gap: Vendor-neutral task qualification and acceptance evidence for humanoids is still sparse.
results.mvp: Task inventory, readiness rubric, constraints, acceptance criteria, pilot evidence and exception log.
results.working_logic: Score candidate tasks using deterministic dimensions such as environment, payload, repeatability, access and acceptance criteria.
results.marketing_strategy: Industrial automation integrators and manufacturing engineering teams.
results.first_customer_plan: Run readiness scoring on 10 manual material-handling tasks at one plant.
results.main_risk: Readiness scoring needs credible domain rubric and must not imply machine-safety certification.

local_scope_evidence.name: Trakya industrial footprint
local_scope_evidence.reason: Trakya has dense manufacturing/industrial investment footprint relevant to automation buyers.

results.local_applicability_rationale: Manufacturing and logistics plants exist in the Trakya corridor, so the buyer/workflow is locally plausible; no claim that humanoids are already deployed there.

global_competitors.name: Formic
global_competitors.reason: Manufacturers identify automation tasks, assess suitability and deploy/measure robotic automation.

global_competitors.name: HowToRobot

adjacent_competitors.name: igus RBTX

competition_search_terms: packaging automation readiness assessment vendor neutral software
Türkiye ambalaj otomasyon fizibilite robot uygunluk yazılımı
results.market_gap: Packaging-specific acceptance/readiness templates can narrow a market already served by broader automation advisory platforms.
results.mvp: Task inventory, readiness rubric, vendor-option matrix, acceptance criteria and evidence.
results.working_logic: Score material-handling tasks, document constraints/options, then track acceptance against predefined criteria.
results.first_customer_plan: Assess one palletizing or roll-handling workflow.
results.main_risk: Generic automation assessment competitors can serve the same core job.
results.validation_assumption: Packaging-specific workflow is differentiated enough while direct count stays within limit.

local_scope_evidence.name: Trakya Development Agency
local_scope_evidence.reason: Regional industrial/food/manufacturing footprint supports relevant buyer presence.

results.local_applicability_rationale: Packaging/food manufacturing is a plausible Trakya workflow; local label reflects buyer footprint, not verified local unmet demand.

global_competitors.name: HirePro
global_competitors.reason: Hiring assessment integrity/fraud controls for recruitment teams.

global_competitors.name: Mercer Mettl
global_competitors.reason: Assessment integrity signals, evidence and review for hiring/assessment workflows.

global_competitors.name: Talview
global_competitors.reason: Recruitment/assessment proctoring and integrity review workflow.

adjacent_competitors.name: TestGorilla
adjacent_competitors.reason: Assessment platform with anti-cheating controls but case-ledger workflow is not the core product.

competition_search_terms: recruitment assessment integrity fraud case management software
Türkiye işe alım sınav güvenliği kopya tespit yazılımı
results.market_gap: A cross-provider evidence case ledger could sit above assessment vendors, but the underlying integrity job has mature competitors.
results.mvp: Signal import/manual entry, case checklist, evidence attachments, reviewer disposition and audit export.
results.working_logic: Normalize integrity signals from different assessment tools into cases for human review and disposition.
results.marketing_strategy: TA operations teams using multiple assessment vendors.
results.first_customer_plan: Pilot with exported integrity flags from one employer's existing assessment tools.
results.main_risk: Assessment vendors may already provide sufficient review dashboards; cross-provider need must be proven.
results.validation_assumption: Product is vendor-neutral case aggregation rather than another proctoring engine.
